provenance.note: Place briefs for 7 Gram Panchayats in PUZHAL block: the verdict derived from the tension between tap coverage and the containing taluk's groundwater category, headline facts each carrying their caveat, the named capability gaps, and the detail behind them (habitations, sources, sampling, land, seasonal sources, boundary, rainfall, water bodies). Briefs fail closed: a place must hold identity, population and drinking-water service before it gets a verdict; otherwise it is directory-only and publishes no numbers.

conventions.status: brief-ready | directory-only; a directory-only brief carries no verdict and no headline facts by rule
conventions.tone: positive | warning | neutral | blocked, the same vocabulary the district page uses
conventions.groundwater: every taluk-grain figure says it describes the taluk, not the Panchayat

briefs.name: Alinjivakkam
briefs.statusReason: Identity, population and drinking-water service are all established.

verdict.title: Universal taps on a source still within its limit
verdict.body: All 480 households report a tap connection and Ponneri remains assessed safe at 37.9 percent of extraction.

headlineFacts.label: Households with a tap connection
headlineFacts.note: 480 of 480 households, across 4 habitations.

headlineFacts.label: Drinking-water sources
headlineFacts.note: Deep Tubewell, Shallow Tubewell

headlineFacts.label: Groundwater extraction, containing taluk
headlineFacts.note: Ponneri is assessed safe. This describes the taluk, not this Panchayat.

headlineFacts.label: Rainfall, last 30 days
headlineFacts.note: 29 rain days between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-06, modelled rather than gauged.

headlineFacts.label: Last water-quality sample
headlineFacts.note: Safe on 2026-08-13. 144 samples over 4 years, none of them recorded unsafe.
